name: control-center
description: Onboard and operate a personal Control Center: credentials, MCP connectors, browser automation, and remote dispatch so one operator can command their computer from anywhere.

interface.shortDescription: Set up and run a remote-controllable command center for your computer.
interface.longDescription: A guided onboarding that installs connectors, stores credentials safely, enables browser automation, and turns on remote dispatch, plus an operating skill that executes broad everyday work on command: email, calendar, research, documents, web pages, and scheduled routines.
defaultPrompt: Use $control-center-setup to build my command center.
